errors.evidence: The y-axis range shown with labeled ticks is from 82% to 90%, not starting from 81%.

The labeled major tick marks on the y-axis have an interval of 2% (82, 84, 86, 88, 90), not 1%. While the grid lines have a 1% interval, describing the 'tick interval' as 1% is incorrect for the main labeled ticks.
The value for the blue line (Precision) at mBERT-100 is approximately 89.2%, which is significantly different from the stated 88.5%.
The value for the red line (Recall) at mBERT-80 is approximately 89.8%, which is almost 90%, not 89.0%.
The value for the green line (F1 Score) at mBERT-80 is approximately 88.7%, not 88.0%.
The value for the green line (F1 Score) at mBERT-100 is approximately 89.7%, not 89.0%.
The description does not state the overall purpose of the chart, which is to show the effect of vocabulary size on model performance, as indicated by the paper's caption.
